purpose: Cross-validation and same-rank projector control for the DENSITY sensitivity-tomography seed.

conclusion.original_two_point_holdout: PASS on the original cold-start split only (raw 0.6764351752 vs P47 0.4524218813).
conclusion.reason: Under exhaustive leave-one-out, P47 RMSE is worse than raw ART and worse than every one of the 47 deterministic same-rank random-projector controls.

scope: Finite 11-observation seed only. This result does not establish a universal statement about P47; it invalidates treating the original two-point split as sufficient evidence of a P47-specific benefit.
